# OneClickDIY

> OneClickDIY offers DIY spray foam insulation kits, sealants, and application tools for thermal and acoustic insulation projects.

OneClickDIY specializes in two-component closed-cell spray foam systems and polyurethane sealants for homeowners and DIY enthusiasts. The site provides fire-rated insulation products, weatherproofing solutions, and specialized foam applications for windows, doors, gaps, and pest prevention.

## Key Topics

- Closed-cell spray foam
- Thermal insulation
- Fire-rated foam (Class A)
- Polyurethane sealants
- DIY insulation kits
- Sound insulation
- Spray foam guns
- Air sealing
- Weatherproofing
- Pest blocking
- Silicone sealants
- Acrylic sealants
- Two-component foam
- Home improvement
